history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration continue to regularly monitor the composition and rotation of Advisory Board members, which should include periodic rotation of members to the extent possible and in view of practical considerations, to ensure that the actual composition is optimized in support of its remit.
history.administration_response: Humanitarian Financing Units, in line with the global guidelines and operational manuals, monitor the rotation of the members of their Advisory Boards on the basis of their respective rotational-in- country cycles. This varies by fund. The relevant information is collected regularly and included in each fund’s annual report. We consider this recommendation to be implemented and request that it be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that Humanitarian Financing Units monitor the rotation of the members of their Advisory Boards and that information about rotation is collected regularly and included in each fund’s annual report, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
